How Does Congestion Affect the Evaluation of Recreational Gate Fees? An Application to Gulf Coast Beaches
abstract: We investigate how congestion influences the welfare, revenue-raising, and distributional implications of gate fees at outdoor recreational sites. A simple conceptual framework decomposes the effects of gate fees into three components, which are then quantified in an application to Gulf Coast beaches. Simulation results suggest that when congestion is a disamenity, the deadweight loss from gate fees declines, the revenue raised grows, and leakage to untaxed sites is less. Congestion feedbacks do not substantively change our distributional analysis, which implies that gate fees are regressive, do not disproportionately affect minorities, and privilege local recreators at the expense of overnight visitors.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了拥挤如何影响户外休闲场所门票（gate fees）的福利、财政收入和分配效应。一个简单的概念框架将门票的效应分解为三个组成部分，随后我们将其应用于墨西哥湾沿岸海滩进行量化。模拟结果表明，当拥挤是一种负效用时，门票带来的无谓损失会下降，财政收入会增加，而流向未征税场所的转移也会减少。拥挤反馈并不会实质性地改变我们的分配分析结果，这意味着门票具有累退性，不会对少数族裔产生不成比例的影响，并且有利于本地休闲者，而牺牲了过夜游客的利益。

title: The Effects of Weather on Recreational Fishing Demand and Adaptation: Implications for a Changing Climate
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Outdoor recreation is one of the most popular leisure activities in the United States, yet the potential impacts of climate change on the nonmarket aspects of this activity are largely unknown or poorly understood. We estimate the nonlinear effects of temperature and precipitation on the demand for a significant segment of the outdoor recreation economy—shoreline marine recreational fishing in the Atlantic and Gulf Coast regions—from 2004 to 2009. Our econometric estimates suggest that extreme heat significantly reduces recreation participation. We find declines in participation (up to 15%) and welfare (up to $312 million annually) over a range of predicted climate futures. These impacts vary spatially and temporally, with warmer locations and times of year experiencing significant losses and gains possible in cooler areas. We also find evidence of climate-averting behavior as anglers shift their activities to nighttime rather than fish less frequently to mitigate the negative impacts from extreme heat.
abstract_zh: 户外休闲是美国最受欢迎的休闲活动之一，然而，气候变化对这一活动非市场方面的潜在影响在很大程度上尚不明确或理解不足。我们估算了气温和降水对户外休闲经济中一个重要组成部分——2004 至 2009 年大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸浅海海岸休闲钓鱼需求——的非线性影响。我们的计量估计表明，极端高温会显著降低休闲参与度。在一系列预测的气候情景下，我们发现参与度下降（最高可达 15%），福利损失（每年最高可达 3.12 亿美元）。这些影响在空间和时间上存在差异，较温暖的地点和季节将出现显著损失，而较凉爽的地区则可能出现收益。我们还发现了气候规避行为的证据：垂钓者将活动转移至夜间，而非减少垂钓频率，以减轻极端高温的负面影响。

Conservation Policies: Who Responds to Price and Who Responds to Prescription?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The efficiency properties of price and non-price instruments for conservation in environmental policy are well understood. Yet, there is little evidence comparing the effectiveness of these instruments, especially when considering water resource management. We exploit a rich panel of residential water consumption to examine heterogeneous responses to both price and non-price conservation policies during times of drought while controlling for unobservable household characteristics. Our empirical models suggest that the burden of pricing policies fall disproportionately on low-income households and fail to reduce consumption among households who generally are large consumers of water. However, prescriptive policies such as restrictions on outdoor water use result in uniform responses across income classes while simultaneously targeting reductions from households with irrigation systems or historically high consumption.
abstract_zh: 在环境政策中，价格型与非价格型节约工具的效率特性已得到充分理解。然而，比较这些工具有效性的证据很少，尤其是在考虑水资源管理时。我们利用丰富的居民用水消费面板数据，考察了干旱期间居民对价格型和非价格型节约政策的异质性反应，同时控制了不可观测的家庭特征。我们的实证模型表明，定价政策的负担不成比例地落在低收入家庭身上，并且未能减少那些通常是大量用水者的家庭的用水量。然而，诸如限制户外用水等规定性政策，会在各收入阶层中产生一致的反应，同时针对拥有灌溉系统或历史上用水量较高的家庭实现减量。

Distributional and Efficiency Impacts of Increased U.S. Gasoline Taxes
abstract: We examine the impacts of increased US gasoline taxes in a model that links the markets for new, used, and scrapped vehicles and recognizes the considerable heterogeneity among households and cars. Household choice parameters derive from an estimation procedure that integrates individual choices for car ownership and miles traveled. We find that each cent-per-gallon increase in the price of gasoline reduces the equilibrium gasoline consumption by about 0.2 percent. Taking account of revenue recycling, the impact of a 25-cent gasoline tax increase on the average household is about $30 per year (2001 dollars). Distributional impacts depend importantly on how additional revenues from the tax increase are recycled. (JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71)
abstract_zh: 我们在一个将新车、二手车和报废车辆市场联系起来的模型中，考察美国汽油税提高的影响，该模型同时承认家庭与汽车之间的显著异质性。家庭的选择参数来自一个将车辆拥有与行驶里程个体选择整合在一起的估计程序。我们发现，汽油价格每提高一美分/加仑，均衡汽油消费量约减少0.2%。考虑税收返还之后，汽油税每加仑提高25美分对普通家庭的影响约为每年30美元（2001年美元）。分配效应在很大程度上取决于增税所得收入的返还方式。（JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71）

title: Estimating the Demand for Quality with Discrete Choice Models (book chapter)
How Do Gasoline Prices Affect Fleet Fuel Economy?
abstract: Exploiting a rich data set of passenger vehicle registrations in twenty U.S. metropolitan statistical areas from 1997 to 2005, we examine the effects of gasoline prices on the automotive fleet's composition. We find that high gasoline prices affect fleet fuel economy through two channels: (1) shifting new and purchases towards more fuel-efficient vehicles, and (2) speeding the scrappage of older, less fuel-efficient used vehicles. Policy simulations based on our econometric estimates suggest that a 10% increase in gasoline prices from 2005 levels will generate a 0.22% increase in fleet fuel economy in the short run and a 2.04% increase in the long run.
abstract_zh: 利用1997至2005年间美国20个大都市统计区内丰富的乘用车登记数据，我们考察了汽油价格对汽车车队构成的影响。我们发现，高油价通过两个渠道影响车队的燃油经济性：（1）推动新车购买转向更省油的车型；（2）加速报废较老、较耗油的二手车。基于我们计量估计结果的政策模拟表明，在2005年水平的基础上，汽油价格上涨10%，短期内将使车队燃油经济性提高0.22%，长期内则提高2.04%。
